label: The 'as' (or the 'a' just after it) when me, us or you is labelled back: an earlier clause has me, us or you seeing, thinking of, regarding or treating someone else as something, and a following clause has that other person see, think of, regard or treat me, us or you 'as' something in return; the return can end in a noun or an adjective. Weak: the same return clause aimed at a third person (him, her, them, a brother), a one-way label of me, us or you with no earlier clause, me labelled first and then answering back, the bare form without 'as' (thinks me foolish, considers me a fool), and official appointments to a post.

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit

qc.label_under_test: The 'as' or 'a' right after me, us or you when that person is labelled back: an earlier clause has me, us or you casting someone else as a kind of person (seeing, thinking of or treating them as something), and a following clause has that other person cast me, us or you in return with a noun. Weak: the same return clause aimed at a third person, a one-way label of me or you with no earlier clause, me labelled first and then answering back, official appointments to a post, and adjective labels.
